lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: jiu dharatee sobh kare jal barasai tiu sikh gur mil bigasaaee ||16||
lines.translation: Just as the earth looks beautiful when the rain falls, so does the Sikh blossom forth meeting the Guru. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਵਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: sevak kaa hoi sevak varataa kar kar binau bulaaee ||17||
lines.translation: I long to be the servant of Your servants; I call upon You reverently in prayer. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee har pahi gur mil gur sukh paaee ||18||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may meet the Guru, and find peace. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਚੁ ਦੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: too aape gur chelaa hai aape gur vich de tujhahi dhiaaee ||19||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the disciple; through the Guru, I meditate on You. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh sevahi so toohai hovahi tudh sevak paij rakhaaee ||20||
lines.translation: Those who serve You, become You. You preserve the honor of Your servants. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: bha(n)daar bhare bhagatee har tere jis bhaavai tis devaaee ||21||
lines.translation: O Lord, Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. One who loves You, is blessed with it. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਰ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis too(n) dehi soee jan paae hor nihaphal sabh chaturaaee ||22||
lines.translation: That humble being alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it. All other clever tricks are fruitless. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar gur apunaa soiaa man jaagaaee ||23||
lines.translation: Remembering, remembering, remembering my Guru in meditation, my sleeping mind is awakened. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: ik daan ma(n)gai naanak vechaaraa har daasan daas karaaee ||24||
lines.translation: Poor Nanak begs for this one blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of the Lord. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਤ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਤ ਗੁਰ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: je gur jhiRake ta meethaa laagai je bakhase ta gur vadiaaee ||25||
lines.translation: Even if the Guru rebukes me, He still seems very sweet to me. And if He actually forgives me, that is the Guru's greatness. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bolahi so thaai paae manamukh kichh thaai na paaee ||26||
lines.translation: That which Gurmukh speaks is certified and approved. Whatever the self-willed manmukh says is not accepted. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਵਰਫ ਵਰਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: paalaa kakar varaph varasai gurasikh gur dekhan jaaee ||27||
lines.translation: Even in the cold, the frost and the snow, the GurSikh still goes out to see his Guru. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਾਈ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: sabh dinas rain dekhau gur apunaa vich akhee gur pair dharaaee ||28||
lines.translation: All day and night, I gaze upon my Guru; I install the Guru's Feet in my eyes. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: anek upaav karee gur kaaran gur bhaavai so thaai paaee ||29||
lines.translation: I make so many efforts for the sake of the Guru; only that which pleases the Guru is accepted and approved. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: rain dinas gur charan araadhee daiaa karahu mere saaee ||30||
lines.translation: Night and day, I worship the Guru's Feet in adoration; have Mercy upon me, O my Lord and Master. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa jeeu pi(n)d guroo hai gur mil tripat aghaaee ||31||
lines.translation: The Guru is Nanak's body and soul; meeting the Guru, he is satisfied and satiated. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੩੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa prabh poor rahio hai jat kat tat gosaaee ||32||1||
lines.translation: Nanak's God is perfectly permeating and all-pervading. Here and there and everywhere, the Lord of the Universe. ||32||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 asatapadeeaa ghar 10 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar sachaa nehu laaiaa preetam aapanai ||
lines.translation: Deep within myself, I have enshrined true love for my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਾਮੑਣੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tan man hoi nihaal jaa gur dekhaa saamhne ||1||
lines.translation: My body and soul are in ecstasy; I see my Guru before me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai har har naam visaahu ||
lines.translation: I have purchased the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore te paaiaa a(n)mrit agam athaahu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Ambrosial Nectar from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau satigur vekh vigaseeaa har naame lagaa piaar ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the True Guru, I blossom forth in ecstasy; I am in love with the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa kar kai melian paaiaa mokh duaar ||2||
lines.translation: Through His Mercy, the Lord has united me with Himself, and I have found the Door of Salvation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur birahee naam kaa je milai ta tan man deu ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Lover of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Meeting Him, I dedicate my body and mind to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਏਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je poorab hovai likhiaa taa a(n)mrit sahaj peeeu ||3||
lines.translation: And if it is so pre-ordained, then I shall automatically drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sutiaa gur saalaaheeai uthadiaa bhee gur aalaau ||
lines.translation: Praise the Guru while you are asleep, and call on the Guru while you are up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: koee aisaa guramukh je milai hau taa ke dhovaa paau ||4||
lines.translation: If only I could meet such a Gurmukh; I would wash His Feet. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee aisaa sajan loR lahu mai preetam dei milaai ||
lines.translation: I long for such a Friend, to unite me with my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai har paaiaa miliaa sahaj subhaai ||5||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, I have found the Lord. He has met me, easily and effortlessly. ||5||
